name: Ryuuguuin Reia
source:
She has a serious personality that is the very picture of good character, but while she hates the sin and not the sinner, she also possesses a flexible mindset and a generous spirit.

When no one is watching, she has a strong girlish side and loves cute things, but she hides this because she feels it doesn’t fit her public image.
translation:
She has a serious personality that is the very picture of good character, but while she hates the sin and not the sinner, she also possesses a flexible mindset and a generous spirit.

When no one is watching, she has a strong girlish side and loves cute things, but she hides this because she feels it doesn’t fit her public image.
